compact.conclusion: 30 distinct repeated mechanical module INSERTs verified. 30 independent closed-loop Tiangong machines is not proved. One vertical level, 1.12 m height, 10 total bins and modeled end cabinets are display assumptions, not source facts.
compact.layout_evidence: 5 containers on each of two sides around a central mechanical rail in plan. Source has repeated module frames, not one uninterrupted 30-station belt. Lifting levels and carrier return path are not inferable from 2D.
compact.visual_mechanism_evidence: Source vector detail shows a central straight rail, travelling platform, end mechanisms and a five-column wheeled bin frame on each side. Not a bare empty cart. Whether return routing/lift is present is not established by this plan.

parallel_container_rows.conclusion: Source depicts containers, not belt rollers. Most groups have 4 parallel rows of 4 plan containers; one west group has 2 rows. Their parent machine identity/height/cart grouping is unknown.

simulation_constraints: Do not copy a 96-bin vendor machine into either footprint solely on a block name or old mesh name.
Treat 5-column compact modules as user-confirmed sorter equipment only if user disambiguates; number of independent machines and vertical levels remain unknown.
Complete cart exchange can be represented as an explicitly labelled CAD-adapted demonstration, but must not claim verified real machine behavior.
Retain exact CAD XY, all 30 module positions, and the central ground-grid/aisle. Do not auto-connect a belt through the ground grid.

long_machine_cart_groups.evidence: Source linework depicts separated caster-supported bin frames: two four-column carts per side (2C9A89), three five-column carts per side (2C9AE5). Vertical levels remain source-model assumption.

classification_scope: 用户要求以原CAD判断设备身份；不再把截图中的口述排数当作整机或备用空车的判定依据。中央短模块与独立容器排分开记录，机构/型号/层数仍按源证据保留未知。
